newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly easier, regular mogas firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly easier, regular mogas firm.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly easier on Tuesday. Only regular gasoline saw any upside, traders said.

Eurograde gasoline spot prices were a softer but tighter regular markets saw prices firmer. On the ARA barge market Eurograde barges traded $214 a tonne fob Rotterdam. Regular was done slightly firmer at $207. Traders said few of the key Rotterdam majors had regular to offer.
Naphtha physical prices were holding steady in quiet trade with cargo offers scarce and buyers relaxed.
Low sulphur diesel premiums gained on good demand. Heating oil premiums was steady.
High sulphur fuel oil tumbled below $100 a tonne fob ARA, under the weight of good supply and poor buying. Low sulphur fuel oil fell by around $3.
